meta.name: two-fund-stress-test
meta.description: A $1M portfolio split between two funds (VTI and VXUS by default), compounded forward ten years under six market scenarios and every split from 0 to 100 — how the money grows or shrinks, whether the split matters, and what the bad years feel like.

fund_a.description: Ticker of the first fund — the one the split percentage refers to. Must have returns for every scenario.

fund_b.description: Ticker of the second fund — receives whatever share the first fund does not.

starting_balance.description: Dollars invested on day one. No money is added or taken out afterwards.

start_year.description: The first forecast year. The dashboard labels calendar years from here.

horizon_years.description: How many years forward to project. The scenario data holds ten years.
